findings.claim: The learning window and score clocks are [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing; curve support is [0.0, 0.49], so no extrapolation beyond the observed nodes is licensed.
The objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; coordinate contrasts are therefore proxies, not affinity labels.

The observed landmark_00_local_dy curve over [0.0,0.49] is non-monotone: it dips to about -1.26 z near t=0.05, rises to about +0.24 z near t=0.18, and returns to about +0.13 z at t=0.49, with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches.

For landmark_00, the continuous-trend table reports no accepted polynomial for any of the ten features (polynomial_accepted=false throughout), with relative_node_RMSE from 0.29 to 0.87 and 4-10 sign changes per feature; the observed-node linear method is the only representation offered.
Whole-window z magnitudes for landmark_00 features are small (|z| <= 0.64), so no landmark_00 coordinate feature shows a dominant net displacement over the full window.

hypotheses.direction: test only; no preferred direction asserted from this contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: If the per-node landmark_00_local_dy curve is stationary (no reproducible sign change across batches) or the registered recipes compile to identical tables, the time-dependent curvature hypothesis is not supported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy observed curve values_z across the 50 score nodes
hypotheses.scope: landmark_00_local_dy, all 14 independent batches, learning window [0.0,0.5]
hypotheses.statement: A time-dependent curvature schedule (registered C1_robust_to_base vs C2_constant_curvature vs C3_base_to_robust_control) may be testable at fixed dose and fixed teachers, because the observed landmark_00_local_dy curve changes direction within the window rather than following a single stationary trend.

hypotheses.direction: retain gradual change; do not introduce a discovered stage boundary
hypotheses.falsifier: An independently stable profile with an accepted polynomial and consistent sign across batches would justify a knot.
hypotheses.observable: polynomial_accepted, sign_changes and strong_sign_conflicts per landmark_00 feature, plus the observed landmark_00_local_dy curve
hypotheses.statement: A gradual (no-knot) schedule is preferable to a data-derived knot for landmark_00 features, because no accepted polynomial and no stable whole-window trend was found, so no reproducible knot location is supported.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; only continuous curves and summary tables were delivered, so no stage-resolved claim is made.
Only landmark_00 features were read; the other 19 landmarks were not queried and no claim is made about them.
No decoded final affinity labels are present (label semantics: recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so coordinate contrasts cannot be equated with affinity improvement.
The observed curve and continuous-trend rows are coordinate contrasts; they do not define an absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient, and no such target is asserted.
No dose or reward effect was measured here; the registered recipes are proposed interventions, not learned optima.
